final: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_rate_ratio FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_group_rebate FROM fee_groups), kept AS (SELECT g.feecoin, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_rate_ratio, g.avg_rebate - o.avg_group_rebate AS rebate_difference FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.avg_rebate > o.avg_group_rebate) SELECT AVG(avg_rebate), AVG(avg_rate_ratio), AVG(rebate_difference) FROM kept
